title: Inventário se arrumando sozinho
concept: A shuffled 6×5 bag of generic loot icons sorts itself row by row on the beat (misplaced items swap places in arcs, counter 5/30 → 30/30) into rainbow rows, lands on 'Farm 100% AFK: tudo no lugar.', and after the lockup scatters back into the exact starting mess for a seamless loop.

youtube.description: Uma bag bagunçada se organizando sozinha, linha por linha, no ritmo. Farm 100% AFK com KizuBot para PokeXGames: tudo no lugar. kizubot.com

notes: Hook shortened from 'INVENTÁRIO SE ORGANIZANDO SOZINHO' to 'INVENTÁRIO SE ARRUMANDO SOZINHO…' so every line stays ≥100 px inside the hook band. Caption changed from 'Assim é o farm com KizuBot: tudo no lugar.' to 'Farm 100% AFK: TUDO NO LUGAR.' so the short never implies KizuBot has an inventory-sorting feature (the sort is a visual metaphor; the only claim is the approved '100% AFK'); brand cue moved to a KizuBot chip in the bag header. Icons are generic CSS/SVG (gem, coin, leaf, drop, berry) — no game sprites or ball designs. Counter counts visible icons in their row, not a statistic. Rubric: hook 8, re-hooks 8, clarity 8, craft 9, truth 9, sound 8, brand 8, CTA 8, loop 9, distinct 9 = 8.4.
